scope.countryGrain: ISO-like country or territory records shipped by the pinned source release
scope.stateGrain: Mixed administrative subdivisions retained from the source; semantic normalization is tracked separately
scope.cityGrain: Source-defined populated places; record counts do not imply an exhaustive settlement register

statuses.available: One or more records are published; this does not by itself prove exhaustiveness.
statuses.missing: Records or metadata are expected but absent from the pinned source snapshot.
statuses.notApplicable: The field or hierarchy is not meaningful for this entity under the documented rule.
statuses.unknown: The snapshot is empty and applicability or authoritative completeness has not yet been verified.

reasonCodes.no-state-records-in-source: The pinned source contains no state/subdivision row for this country or territory.
reasonCodes.no-city-records-in-source: The pinned source contains no populated-place row for this country or territory.
reasonCodes.child-coverage-unverified: The state exists, but the snapshot contains no child place and no authoritative completeness decision.
reasonCodes.upstream-field-empty: The pinned source leaves a required country metadata field empty.
reasonCodes.no-standard-admin-hierarchy: No standard state-like administrative hierarchy is applicable to the uninhabited territory.
reasonCodes.no-permanent-settlement: Official territorial information reports no permanent resident settlement to model as a city.
reasonCodes.no-official-capital: The territory has no fixed official capital.
reasonCodes.un-m49-region-not-assigned: UN M49 intentionally leaves the region and subregion blank.
reasonCodes.aggregate-has-no-single-centre: The record is an aggregation of separate islands and has no defensible single centre coordinate.
reasonCodes.aggregate-child-place-scope-unverified: The aggregate contains separate islands, but a complete child-place register has not been verified.
reasonCodes.coordinate-missing-in-source: The source does not provide a usable representative centre coordinate.
reasonCodes.partial-coordinate: Only one member of the latitude/longitude pair is populated.
